rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides comprehensive integration with the Zoho Projects API, enabling AI assistants to manage projects, tasks, issues, milestones, and users across Zoho Projects portals. Built by qpiai with dual transport support (stdio for local clients like Claude Desktop and HTTP/SSE for remote access), it features automatic OAuth token refresh, multi-session management, and 20 specialized tools covering portal operations, project lifecycle management, task and issue tracking, phase management, search functionality, and user administration. The implementation includes robust error handling, pagination support, and region-specific API domain configuration, making it useful for project management automation, task tracking workflows, and building AI-powered project management assistants that need deep integration with Zoho's project management ecosystem.
